author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Hijab-wearing figure (tall round hood framing the face opening, sides sweeping in to the robed body) kneeling on a prayer mat drawn in perspective as a trapezoid whose top edge passes behind the body, as in the reference. The current drawing put a ring-and-dot eye inside a faceted dome above a detached U-shaped tray, so it read as a one-eyed robot on a stand rather than a person on a mat.
omissions: The face is an arch open at the chin (a closed ring inside the hood read as a single eye); the reference's arm lines and scarf edge are omitted at 8 spacing.
